questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **give up**.
questions.explanation: 'give up' means: to stop trying or quit.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **look into**.
questions.explanation: 'look into' means: to investigate or examine.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **carry out**.
questions.explanation: 'carry out' means: to perform or conduct (a task/experiment).

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **run out of**.
questions.explanation: 'run out of' means: to have none left.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **put off**.
questions.explanation: 'put off' means: to postpone or delay.

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the phrasal verb: **turn down**.
questions.explanation: 'turn down' means: to refuse or reject.
